page.overview:
Who is Mallory?

Mallory, Sr. was the father of security officer Lieutenant Mallory.

In 2252, he helped a young James T. Kirk get into Starfleet Academy. After assuming command of the Enterprise, Kirk repayed the favor by having Mallory's son serve aboard his ship. Unfortunately, the younger Mallory was killed by Vaal in 2267. ()
